sources.title: Anthropic, PBC Amendment No. 2 to Form S-1, November 10, 2026

event.title: Anthropic launches its initial public offering roadshow
event.summary: Anthropic filed its initial registration statement on October 26 and launched the roadshow on November 10 for an offering of Class A common stock. Strategic partners agreed to a concurrent private placement, which is recorded as a separate event.

quantities.label: Class A shares in the proposed offering
quantities.quote: This is an initial public offering of shares of Class A common stock of Anthropic, PBC. We are selling 801,351,354 shares of Class A common stock and the selling stockholders identified in this prospectus are selling an additional 23,648,646 shares of Class A common stock.

quantities.label: Additional shares covered by the underwriters’ option
quantities.quote: the underwriters have the option to purchase up to an additional 123,750,000 shares of Class A common stock from Anthropic, PBC at the initial public offering price less the underwriting discount.

facts.label: Initial filing
facts.text: Anthropic filed its initial Form S-1 on October 26, 2026.
facts.quote: As filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on October 26, 2026.

facts.label: Expected price range
facts.text: The initial public offering price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share.
facts.quote: It is currently estimated that the initial public offering price per share will be between $70.00 and $78.00.

facts.label: Listing plan
facts.text: Anthropic applied to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under ANT.
facts.quote: We have applied to list our Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol "ANT."

relations.note: The concurrent private placement is contingent on this offering.
